name: School Transportation Operations

products.name: Route Change Acknowledgment
products.product: A focused school bus route change communication workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small school-bus contractors and private student-transportation operators
products.problem: Stop, time, student, school, access, vehicle, and family-notice changes may not reach every driver and dispatcher before service.
products.valueProposition: Turns school bus route change communication into a visible operating queue so every effective route change has a current version, affected-party acknowledgment, and first-run verification.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets school bus route change communication software, school bus route change communication tracker, school bus route change communication template, and school bus route change communication checklist searches.
